name: deepseek-worker
description: Lets Claude Code hand simple tasks to a DeepSeek model on your own Anthropic-compatible gateway.

base_url.title: Gateway URL
base_url.description: Base URL of an Anthropic-compatible Messages API, without /v1/messages.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name as the gateway knows it.

session_id.title: Session id
session_id.description: Optional. Sent in the session header, if the profile names one. Use your username.

session_header.title: Session header
session_header.description: Optional. Header the gateway uses to keep your requests on one engine.

help.title: Help text
help.description: Optional. Added to key and rate-limit errors, such as where to ask for help.

requests_per_minute.title: Requests per minute
requests_per_minute.description: Optional. Rate limit this plugin keeps to.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The command that runs Python 3.9 or later on this machine, such as python3, python or py. The installer finds it.
